Omar Haddad: FYI CloudBazaar reached out to co-run a 40m joint session July 22. They want a live Private deploy + short hardware accel demo (EdgeCube). Need speakers, a short run-of-show, rehearsal slots, and swag plan that works EU/NA/APAC. Lina, you free to coordinate?
Lina Park: I can take lead. I can present the Private deployment piece (~8m). Who can demo EdgeCube?
Vikram Rao: I can do the EdgeCube portion. Suggest Plan A: live accelerator node attached to Private; Plan B: short recorded clip + Console walkthrough.
Maya Singh: Ops note: we'll need 2 reserved nodes for rehearsal and the live window. logistics-bot, can you reserve and add a tag cloudbazaar-demo?
logistics-bot: reserved: 2 nodes tagged cloudbazaar-demo from 2026-07-20T09:00:00Z to 2026-07-23T20:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:
Omar Haddad: Run-of-show idea: 1) 5m intro (hosts) 2) 10m Private deep-dive 3) 12m live EdgeCube demo 4) 8m customer Q&A + 5m closing. Keep slides light.
Lina Park: Also need a short fallback script if EdgeCube misbehaves: cut to recorded demo then show degraded CPU fallback metrics. Vikram, can you prep 90s highlight + 6m full recording?
Vikram Rao: Yep. Will upload to s3://redwood-media/cloudbazaar-jul22/ and add raw+compressed. Also will add a test harness and smoke test snippet.
Maya Singh: Swag: CloudBazaar will include promo vouchers. Propose Redwood sends 75 sticker packs and 40 phone-stand giveaways. Need customs paperwork for EU and APAC micro-warehouses. Lina, can you collect SKU/weights?
Lina Park: I'll collect packing list and ask marketing for SKUs by EOD. Rehearsal windows: tech check 2 days prior (30m) and full dress 1 day prior (45m). Who can attend?
Vikram Rao: I can do tech check on 2026-07-20 14:00 UTC and dress on 2026-07-21 10:00 UTC.
Omar Haddad: Good. Also need recording + transcript. logistics-bot, enable recording and post to S3 and share with partners.
logistics-bot: recording scheduled for event_id=cloudbazaar-jul22. post-processing will deliver video+vtt to s3://redwood-media/cloudbazaar-jul22/ and notify partners.
Lina Park: I'll assemble a short runbook with owners, rehearsal invites, and a contingency plan. Will post links here when ready. Thanks everyone. :v:
